method: Six blind Opus readers, 8 chunks each, none permitted to open any cruces file; every chunk named clean or with findings, rejected candidates named with reasons
note: 8 our-side defects found and fixed: a-se agency reversal at 0502D (cleansing transferred to Christ), a-perficiendo separation read as location at 0428C, expugnant given the wrong subject at 0439B, two [sic:] quarantines that had swallowed the clause's only verb (0491B) and the earthly half of an antithesis (0490D), a feminine relative mis-bound to Christ at 0493A, a silent person-switch mid-run at 0502B-C, and four co-subjects collapsed to one at 0457C. Separately fixed: five spelled-out chapter heads against the plate's numerals plus one split-chapter head wording mismatch (heads are indexed), and eight undeclared bare-bracket supplies that scan-raw-markers cannot see. Left unrepaired and logged: infractus at 0468B, undisclosed quam-to-quae at 0483C, experte/ex-parte at 0522A, Si vero imo at 0461A, and Migne-side cruces at 0423C, 0459D and 0517C (Ecclesia triumphans for militans).
